name: 食品を無駄にしない予約を終えた案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE Japanese Lighthouse food-saving reservation thank-you component LH19-0020, compact complete portrait on pure white#FFFFFF canvas.
Image1 ORIGINAL Too Good To Go has highest authority for composition, control proportions, spacing and fine details. Image2 protected ORIGINAL bag photograph/logo art: preserve exact teal shopping bag, white3-petal outline logo and curved Latin wordmark「TOO GOOD TO GO」, vegetable arrangement (striped eggplant left, tomato, yellowpepper, basil right), paper folds, shadows, crop and original colors. Do NOT recolor/repaint/rebrand/simplify the logo or photograph. Image3 Japanese mock SECONDARY content/layout. Image4 approved Lighthouse style only, no bus content.
Exact Japanese title「ありがとうございます！」MeiryoBold20/28. Two regular body lines:
「食事が無駄にならないよう、」
「ご協力いただきありがとうございます。」
Then original bag artwork centered at useful modest size, not full-screen. Bottom primary full-width pill「続ける」, smooth forest gradient#174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, readable white regular14/24 label, restrained rim/shadow.
Japanese body MeiryoRegular14/24, metadata12/16 where needed, tracking0. Preserve mock wrapping and all original bag artwork. White card with modest rounded corners, fine neutral outline and soft downward elevation; outside always pure white, any warm background confined to original photo crop. Source teal text action translates to official forest brand, natural teal bag is protected unchanged. No new accent, confetti, successcheck, ready-to-pickup claim, reservationnumber, metrics, extra control, English UI outside protected wordmark, gloss, clipping or watermark. This is thanks AFTER reservation, not food readiness.
reviewNotes: 原本・バッグ原画・日本語モック・編集状態を実見。ありがとうございます！と本文2行、続ける、ティールのバッグ・原ロゴ／TOO GOOD TO GO文字・4種野菜の配置と色を確認。食品準備完了を追加せず予約後の感謝として保持。通常UIは白と墨、主要操作は森林色、保護されたバッグの色は変更しない。欠けなし。画素／フォント数値の厳密比較・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
